note: Reference: the cloth robe's menu, raised on both apps by the same bridge command with the robe in the pack. The five header leaves are quoted RELATIVE to each app's own popup top line (see `anchor`), because they are about the header's CONTENT -- with absolute rects they also silently scored the popup's PLACEMENT, and Raves' popup sits a constant 16px lower, which made a pixel-accurate header read as broken. That offset is now its own leaf, popup_placement.

leaves.note: the item name line inside that block -- 'cloth robe [AV]1 [DV]0'

leaves.note: same line, palette only: badge blue plus the name greys

leaves.name: popup_placement
leaves.note: the popup's own top-line placement, absolute: Raves sits 16px low (constant across a 5- and a 7-option menu)
